query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phone IS NOT NULL AND phone != '' AND phone != '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_phone,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phone IS NULL OR phone = '' OR phone = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_phone
FROM elite_students;
